notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42656026/7e23362407a539d29c671011b6d592e5f06eaefe.jpg[/img]

Today’s patch brings a collection of fixes aimed at improving gameplay stability! Among these fixes, we have addressed issues around card interactions and resolved a few bugs impacting specific platforms. 

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Corrected instance of being allowed to play more than one Ranger into your city.
[*] Legendary card effects can no longer be copied.
[*] Cirrus Windfall should now be playable into a full city.
[*] Fixed issue with Steam Deck not selecting cards correctly.
[*] Fixed a softlock instance related to Pass and Play.
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing Glimmergold! Everdell 1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42656026/ba8193c5d10224a13c7eb7f2bd195d825c0bb874.png[/img]

[i]Extra! Extra! [/i]A new journey is coming to the enchanting world of Everdell! Whether you’re mixing and matching new ways to play or integrating new Legends into your deck, this update brings us a new season to discover!

[h1]What’s New:[/h1]
[i]Glimmergold[/i] introduces three new ways to play [i]Everdell[/i] that you can mix-and-match to your perfect fit:
[list]
[*] [b]Extra! Extra:[/b] A new set of cards to mix-and-match with for your perfect set!
[*] [b]Legends:[/b] Legendary critters and constructions are powerful new cards that can super-charge your city!
[*] [b]Rugwort[/b]: Hide your valuables! The mischievous Rugwort has arrived with three new cards that will allow you to interfere with your opponents plans like never before!
[/list]

[h2]New Achievements and Challenges![/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixes & Improvements:
[*] Fixed several instances of softlocks.
[*] Fixed several instances of notifications not sending correctly.
[*] Fixed several visual bugs.
[*] Fixed several camera-related issues.
[*] Fixed multiple gameplay issues, including:
[list]
[*] Harvester/Gatherer
[*] Fool-related fixes
[*] Tutorial-related fixes [/list]
[*] Fixed instances of AI not taking over for timed-out players in async games.
[*] Updated controller prompt iconography.
[*] Dire Wolf Game Room button now displays on the landing screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Everdell – Glimmergold arrives 9/24!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42656026/ba8193c5d10224a13c7eb7f2bd195d825c0bb874.png[/img]

Prepare to dive back into the magical world of Everdell with Glimmergold expansion bringing even more thrills to your woodland adventures on September 24th!

[h1]Discover New Ways to Play![/h1]
Glimmergold introduces three thrilling additions that you can mix-and-match to create your perfect Everdell experience!

[h1]Extra! Extra! [/h1]
The carnival has rolled into Everdell! New cards bring fresh opportunities to light up your city and entertain your critters like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42656026/32ec18f1f090801b1c82b8b831d10e174f13315c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42656026/fe442cb7ff2b1aee4176accc771f722eed17ab62.png[/img]

[h1]Legends![/h1]
News of your reputation has spread, and now legendary critters and constructions are making their way to your city! These powerful new cards with Legendary critters and constructions can supercharge your strategy:
[list]
[*] At the start of each game, receive a Legendary Critter and Construction in your hand. They don’t count towards your card limit!
[*] Pay the resource cost to play a Legendary card or replace a matching card in your city to play it for free!
[*] Each Legendary card opens up an extra slot in your city, allowing for even more epic combinations!
[/list]

[h1]Rugworts[/h1]
Lock up those goodies! The notorious Rugwort is back with three new cards designed to disrupt your opponents plans like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42656026/c11ed2f5795b908f36c3fc69d5440a413c6c07b4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42656026/270eb7c4d4f858a6126dde47b45a8bb8fc3aa8cb.png[/img]

[h1]New Achievements & Challenges Await! [/h1]
Show off your [i]Everdell [/i]prowess! Whether you’re a season vet of [i]Everdell[/i] or a newcomer, there’s plenty more to explore and master. 

Mark your calendar for [u][b]September 24[/b][/u], and get ready to write your own chapter of woodland glory!

notes.title: Critters' Chitter! Everdell Patch Notes 1.1.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42656026/665b0cdf4948c51983bdc89c8029228bca91f1d2.jpg[/img]

[i]As summer turns to fall, we are excited to bring you the latest Everdell update![/i]

[h1]Features[/h1]
We're excited to introduce a change aimed at enhancing the card viewing experience for mobile players. In response to player feedback, we've added a new option in the gameplay section of settings called "Tap to View Card." When activated, this feature brings several improvements to the game to make reviewing cards more user-friendly:

[list]
[*] Tap to Zoom: Say goodbye to the tap-and-hold method for zooming in on cards in your hand, city, meadow, or pop-ups. With "Tap to View Card" enabled, simply tap on a card to zoom in.
[*] Center-Screen Zoom: Zoomed-in cards will now appear front and center on your screen, providing a clear and immersive view. To dismiss the card, just tap anywhere outside of it.
[*] Streamlined Interactions: We've optimized various interactions that used to require clicking on a card to prevent any conflicts with the new tap-to-zoom functionality.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Going forward, only online games add to Competitor and Seasoned Competitor Achievements.
[*] We fixed some issues with layering and clipping when dragging cards or workers around the playmat.
[*] We increased the hitbox for your city when dragging a card to it and releasing the card near the city’s edge.
[/list]
[h2]Community Bug Fixes[/h2]
Our gratitude goes out to the Everdell community for helping us identify the following bugs which are now resolved:

[list]
[*] We fixed a bug where the player gains Shopkeeper's berry when playing the Fool to another player’s city.
[*] We fixed a bug so that Crane and all other cards properly reset their occupied status when discarded.
[*]We fixed a bug so that 2 Rangers cannot occupy a city when Dungeon is played.
[/list]

We appreciate your continued support and dedication to making [i]Everdell [/i]a place with fewer bugs than critters. Keep the feedback coming, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Quality of Life and Localization [Everdell Patch Notes 1.1.6]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42656026/b76da20dd65a9804f95cb5f5446f49a400fe4fdd.png[/img]

Hello there, critters!

In this patch, we're introducing an optional new method for placing workers on mobile devices, along with a range of bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience.

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added support for an optional new method of placing workers on mobile devices. Users can now place workers in two taps instead of using drag functionality (which is still supported).[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where occupied constructions remained occupied when discarded, shuffled, and drawn again.
[*] Improved the accuracy of timer tooltips.
[*] Fixed an issue where skipping the "Discard cards to draw 2 Per" Forest location caused the placement to be undone.
[*] Users can no longer accidentally drop workers in locations they couldn't see behind their player HUD.
[*] Fixed an issue where cards could be played to the city without being dragged to the correct drop area.
[*] Resolved a softlock that occurred when simultaneously pressing the right and left mouse buttons.
[*] Fixed visual issues that could occur when Rugworts played too many cards.
[*] Cancel option is now available when making a selection of paired Harvester and Gatherers.
[*] Various fixes for non-English localization translations
[/list]

We are [i]extremely[/i] grateful and appreciative of your feedback! If you encounter any bugs or have any suggestions, please don't hesitate to contact us using the in-game feedback option or email Support@DireWolfDigital.com.

Thanks for playing [i]Everdell[/i]! 

[i]Key Note: Nintendo Switch Patch may see a delay ranging from hours to a day.[/i]

notes.title: Everdell Patch 1.1.4
notes.content:
[h2]New – Avatar Select![/h2]

The critters have spoken! By popular demand, today's 1.1.4 patch lets players select their avatar at the start of a game! Are you a squirrel or a mouse?

The full list of patch notes can be seen below:

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players can now select which worker they want to use before the start of the game!
[*] Controller support is now active on PC! Simply plug in your controller to activate or toggle it on in the settings menu.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed some instances where players were prompted that they could spend additional resources even when they had no more to spend.
[*] Resolved animation issues involving Rugwort’s vines.
[*] Fixed a bug where Rugwort wasn’t calculating his point total correctly in some situations.
[*] Players can no longer play cards out of Rugwort’s city after playing a Teacher.
[/list]

notes.title: Everdell Patch 1.1.2
notes.content:
Everdell’s 1.1.2 patch is about to go live and addresses a variety of bugs and feedback reported by the community. The full list of patch notes can be seen below:

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards now display information about how points are accumulated.
[*] The previous hidden achievement has now been made into a real one, allowing players to complete the entire achievement set.
[*] A warning prompt is displayed to players who attempt to take 0 resources while using Haven.
[*] A change was made to the Judge prompt to better communicate how the card works.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Prompts that alert the player that there is an update available are now skinned and localized correctly.
[*] Players are no longer able to play a 2nd ranger.
[*] Fixed a number of issues revolving around selections when a Harvester and Gatherer are paired together.
[*] You can no longer steal workers from your opponent if they place a worker on your location that you’ve destroyed with Ruins.
[*] Traveler cards now only activate production cards once when played in the New Frontier Challenge.
[*] Workers are now returned at the end of a season when University is used on a location with a Worker on it.
[*] You can no longer play to a Queen with a full city when you have a Crane.
[*] Opponents should now get their workers back the following season if a construction card is discarded.
[*] The Ranger now allows players to move workers in the Late Start Challenge.
[*] Fixed a number of issues around the Ancient Scrolls event not working correctly when there were less than 5 cards in the draw deck.
[*] Fixed a number of issues around longer messages and usernames not displaying correctly in some interfaces.
[/list]

notes.title: Everdell Update 1.1.1.426
notes.content:
Everdell's Update 1.11.426 contains several bugfixes to improve play and ensure achievements are being awarded properly.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the discard deck was not being ordered correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where players weren’t earning certain achievements in-game.
Players will need to complete a single tutorial to retrigger the Graduate achievement and complete a single challenge to retrigger the Challenger and Ultimate Challenger achievements.
[*] Fixed a bug where Rugwort’s name in the action log was difficult to read.
[*] The Meadow button tooltip was shortened.
[/list]

As always, if you're enjoying playing [i]Everdell[/i], please take a moment to leave a review – it's the best way to help other players discover the game. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Everdell Patch 1.1.0.409
notes.content:
Everdell’s 1.1.0.409 patch is now live and addresses a variety of bugs and feedback reported by the community. The full list of patch notes can be seen below:

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new button has been added to the HUD to allow users to view all of the cards in the Meadow on the screen at once!
[*] The size of cards displayed on screen has been increased on mobile platforms.
[*] The maximum distance you can zoom in on the game board has increased.
[*] The size of tooltips on mobile platforms has been increased.
[*] When a worker is moved to a forest location for potential placement, the highlight around the location’s benefits has been increased for better visibility.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Chip Sweep was activating in a player’s city instead of the opponent’s city when copied by Miner Mole.
[*] Fixed a bug where canceling the Post Office’s effect after giving cards to the opponent did not return the cards.
[*] Fixed a bug where a player was unable to play the Fool on Rugwort with a full city.
[*] Fixed an issue where games were locking up when a user resigned during another player’s selection prompt.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not place a unique critter into a Dungeon to play a copy of the unique critter.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not play Ruins to a full city.
[*] Additional changes were made around how the Dungeon and Crane are played.
[*] Other miscellaneous bug fixes, localization updates, and optimizations.
[/list]

We are still investigating other potential issues related to the Crane and the Dungeon. If you come across any problems with them, please use the feedback tool in game via settings to send a game report to us.

As always, if you’re enjoying playing Everdell, please take a moment to leave a review – it’s the best way to help other players discover the game, Thanks for your support!
